functional_details.question: 各学院的平均绩点排名
functional_details.sql_llm:
SELECT s.college, AVG(e.score) AS avg_score
FROM enrollments e
JOIN students s ON e.student_id = s.student_id
WHERE e.status = 'completed' AND e.score IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.college
ORDER BY avg_score DESC

functional_details.question: 每个学院的平均绩点排名
functional_details.sql_llm:
SELECT s.college, AVG(e.score) AS avg_score
FROM enrollments e
JOIN students s ON e.student_id = s.student_id
WHERE e.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY s.college
ORDER BY avg_score DESC
